Checks.Name: Independent half-rate interpolation and finite tail
Independent fractional loop interpolation wraps next tap
Sustain loop exits into sample tail after release
Continuous loop remains looping through release
Forced key replaces played key for pitch
Large step crosses multiple loops without losing phase
Fractional-step loops match an independent piecewise waveform

Meaning: Independent sample oscillator values, loop/release behavior and pitch ratios. No envelopes, filters, controller modulation or complete synthesizer fidelity.
